instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, full shot. In a cozy bedroom with floral wallpaper and a woven rug, a family exercises together. The bearded man in a white t-shirt and striped pajama pants (R1) planks on the rug, facing right. Sitting on his back is the woman in a white button-down shirt and white pajama pants (R3), smiling as she holds the hands of the blonde toddler in striped pajamas (R2). The toddler sits behind the woman on the planking man's lower back. Soft, natural indoor light illuminates the scene, creating a warm and gentle atmosphere.
